description: List resolved Polymarket and Kalshi markets with their result, close time and last recorded price before the close, oldest first, filtered by date (since), category (Crypto, Sports, Elections…) and platform; paginated with cursor. Data is delayed by at least 24 hours (independently recorded from the public Polymarket and Kalshi APIs; not affiliated). Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.

category.description: Case-insensitive substring of the market category, max 64 characters (e.g. Crypto, Sports, Elections, Financials, Politics, Economics, Weather). Default: all categories.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token: the next_cursor value of the previous page, passed unchanged with the same since, category and platform. Default: first page.

limit.description: Resolutions per page: integer from 1 to 100. Default: 50.

platform.description: Platform: polymarket or kalshi (lower case). Default: both platforms.

since.description: Only resolutions detected strictly after this instant: ISO-8601 date-time in UTC ('Z') or with an offset (2026-11-20T12:00:00Z, 2026-11-20T13:00:00+01:00), a plain date (2026-11-20 = midnight UTC) or Unix epoch seconds (1795132800). Default: the data cutoff (now minus 24 h) minus 7 days. Results are sorted oldest first.

name: prediction_resolutions
title: Recently resolved prediction markets
